merge into t using s on t.i=s.i when matched and s.a>4 then update set a=s.a when not matched then insert (i) values(s.i) when not matched by source then delete returning merge_action()
MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.i = s.i WHEN MATCHED AND s.a > 4 THEN UPDATE SET a = s.a WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (i) VALUES (s.i) WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN DELETE RETURNING merge_action()

WITH c AS (UPDATE t SET x = x + 1 RETURNING x) INSERT INTO another SELECT * FROM c
